---
title: "What airspeed does it trim at when ballasted to the required CG?"
---

{{< include _model.qmd >}}

```{python}
ENTRY_CEILING = 90.0   # s for this render, granted by the user
SOLVE_BUDGET = 15.0     # s for any one solve
PROBE_POOL = 200.0        # s granted for the probe
PROBE_SPENT = 26.9      # s the probe actually used

mass, cg = get_mass_properties(get_airplane())
mac = get_airplane().c_ref

op1 = asb.OperatingPoint(velocity=10, alpha=0)
aero1 = asb.AeroBuildup(airplane=get_airplane(), op_point=op1).run()
op2 = asb.OperatingPoint(velocity=10, alpha=1)
aero2 = asb.AeroBuildup(airplane=get_airplane(), op_point=op2).run()

CL_alpha = (aero2["CL"] - aero1["CL"]) / np.radians(1)
Cm_alpha = (aero2["Cm"] - aero1["Cm"]) / np.radians(1)

x_np = get_airplane().xyz_ref[0] - mac * Cm_alpha / CL_alpha
req_cg = float(np.array(x_np - 0.1 * mac).flatten()[0])

op_trim = asb.OperatingPoint(velocity=10, alpha=0)
aero_trim = asb.AeroBuildup(airplane=get_airplane(), op_point=op_trim, xyz_ref=[req_cg, 0, get_airplane().xyz_ref[2]]).run()
cm_0 = float(np.array(aero_trim["Cm"]).flatten()[0])
```

::: {.hero}
None
[Cannot trim upright]{.hero-label}
:::

**Answer.** It cannot trim at any airspeed. With a symmetric flat-plate wing and no incidence, the pitching moment at zero lift is [`{python} f"{cm_0:.3f}"`]{.key}. Combined with a stable 10% static margin, the aircraft requires a negative lift coefficient to achieve zero pitching moment, meaning it cannot produce the upward lift required to balance its weight in level flight.

```{python}
#| label: fig-pitching-moment
#| fig-cap: "Pitching moment versus lift coefficient at the required CG. The aircraft crosses zero pitching moment only at negative lift, precluding upright trim."
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

alphas = np.linspace(-5, 10, 16)
cms = []
cls = []
for a in alphas:
    op = asb.OperatingPoint(velocity=10, alpha=a)
    aero = asb.AeroBuildup(airplane=get_airplane(), op_point=op, xyz_ref=[req_cg, 0, get_airplane().xyz_ref[2]]).run()
    cms.append(float(np.array(aero["Cm"]).flatten()[0]))
    cls.append(float(np.array(aero["CL"]).flatten()[0]))

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6, 4))
ax.plot(cls, cms, 'k.-')
ax.axhline(0, color='gray', linestyle='--')
ax.axvline(0, color='gray', linestyle='--')
ax.set_xlabel("Lift coefficient $C_L$")
ax.set_ylabel("Pitching moment $C_m$")
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
